subject: Graduate / Junior Estimator application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi WIP Construction team,

I'm applying for the Graduate / Junior Estimator role in Cairns, advertised on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I designed road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD and prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, reviewing drawings, tracking procurement and materials and writing progress reports. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I'm open to discussing a move to Cairns.

Your advert says you will teach estimating to someone who wants to learn how projects are priced and delivered, and that is what I'm after. My estimating so far is coursework, not a paid estimating role.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
